fields.why: Table 1 tests influenza positivity and percentage vaccinated across 5 age groups and 4 race/ethnicity groups with chi-square, and the text states both differed.
Age and race/ethnicity are the SPD margins with 3+ groups; sex is a pair, and study site and self-rated health are not SPDs.

The Table 1 chi-squares are r x c tests with the SPD as a margin (rule 2: omnibus). VE across 3 age groups ('higher among children... lower among adults aged 18-49') is compared with no test across age; the chi-square belongs to Table 1, so the mechanical flag on that entry is a false alarm.
